name: Shido
source:
A mysterious half-beast bull who Asahi found passed out. Due to his amnesia, he has no recollection of his past. His behavior is often compared to that of a child, lacking in common sense and moral awareness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664240/Norns_Dine/]Steam[/url]]
